about: LeetCode patterns from design-gurus/grokking-coding-interview (CC BY 4.0), checked 2026-11-12. when/cost/idea are the repo's text; zh is a short Chinese summary. lc: the repo's problems for the pattern as their LeetCode equivalents [number, slug, title, difficulty, premium, extra]; extra=1 means added here because the repo has too few free ones. plan: each LeetCode problem of the morning plan -> pattern number (null = none of the 41).

links.title: Recognize the Pattern
links.zh: 看到陌生题目时，怎么从输入结构、关键词、复杂度要求判断用哪种算法；还有一张 Decision Tree。

links.title: Patterns
links.zh: 每种都有 Recognize it when、核心原理、复杂度、常见错误。学一个 pattern 就看它对应的 .md。

links.title: Problems
links.zh: 按 pattern 分类的练习题和难度。可以从这里挑题，再去 LeetCode 用 Python 写。

links.title: All 41 Patterns Cheat Sheet
links.zh: 每种 pattern 的识别信号、思路、复杂度和典型陷阱汇总在一起。

patterns.name: Two Pointers
patterns.when: Sorted input, looking for a pair or triplet, or an in-place rewrite
patterns.idea: Two indices walk the same array instead of two nested loops, which turns an O(n²) scan into a single O(n) pass.
patterns.zh: 有序数组里找一对或三个数，或者原地改写数组：两个下标从两头往中间走（或者一个读一个写同向走），把 O(n²) 的双循环变成 O(n)。
lc: Two Sum II - Input Array Is Sorted

patterns.name: Fast and Slow Pointers
patterns.when: Linked list, cycle or middle, and no extra memory allowed
patterns.idea: Two pointers move through the same structure at different speeds, and the gap between them reveals cycles, midpoints, and repetition without any extra memory.
patterns.zh: 链表找环、找中点、找倒数第 k 个，而且不能用额外空间：快指针一次走两步、慢指针走一步，相遇就说明有环。

patterns.name: Sliding Window
patterns.when: A contiguous subarray or substring, longest or shortest
patterns.idea: Carry the answer for one window forward to the next one, so a range of the array costs O(1) per step instead of being recomputed from scratch.
patterns.zh: 连续子数组或子串的最长、最短、满足某个条件：右边扩、左边缩，窗口里的统计量随进随出更新，O(n)。
lc: Longest Substring with At Most K Distinct Characters
Find All Anagrams in a String
Substring with Concatenation of All Words

patterns.name: Merge Intervals
patterns.when: Ranges that may overlap: meetings, bookings, time slots
patterns.idea: Sort the intervals by start time, and a problem about overlapping ranges becomes a single left-to-right sweep.
patterns.zh: 区间可能重叠（会议、预订、时间段）：先按起点排序，再从左到右扫一遍，合并或者计数。

patterns.name: Cyclic Sort
patterns.when: Values are a dense range 1 to n, and one is missing or duplicated
patterns.idea: When the values are a known range like 1 to n, every value already knows which index it belongs at, so you can sort in O(n) with no extra memory.
patterns.zh: 数字是 1 到 n 的连续范围，找缺失或重复的数：把每个数换到它该在的位置，再扫一遍看哪里不对。
lc: Find All Numbers Disappeared in an Array
Find All Duplicates in an Array

patterns.name: In-place Reversal of a Linked List
patterns.when: Reverse all or part of a list, in place
patterns.idea: Rewire the next pointers as you walk, and a linked list reverses itself using three variables and no extra memory.
patterns.zh: 原地反转整条或一段链表：用 prev、curr、next 三个指针，边走边改指向。
lc: Reverse Nodes in Even Length Groups

patterns.name: Stacks
patterns.when: Nesting, matching, undo, or "the most recent"
patterns.idea: A stack always hands back the most recent unfinished item, which is exactly what matching, nesting, and undo problems ask for.
patterns.zh: 括号匹配、嵌套、撤销、"最近的那个"：后进先出，遇到开括号压栈，遇到闭括号弹栈比对。

patterns.name: Monotonic Stack
patterns.when: Next or previous greater or smaller element, spans, histograms
patterns.idea: Keep the stack sorted, and every element you pop has just been answered by the element that pushed it out.
patterns.zh: 下一个（或上一个）更大或更小的元素、跨度、柱状图面积：栈里保持单调，新元素进来时弹出所有被它"解决"的元素。
lc: Remove All Adjacent Duplicates In String
Remove All Adjacent Duplicates in String II

patterns.name: Hash Maps
patterns.when: Seen before, how many times, or grouped by a computed key
patterns.idea: Remember what you have already seen, keyed by value, and a nested search collapses into a single pass.
patterns.zh: 见过没有、出现几次、按算出来的 key 分组：用 dict 或 set，把"往回找"变成 O(1) 的查询。
lc: First Unique Character in a String

patterns.name: Tree Level Order Traversal
patterns.when: An answer per level, or the shallowest match
patterns.idea: A queue visits a tree one level at a time, so the first node that matches is always the one closest to the root.
patterns.zh: 每一层要一个答案，或者找最浅的那个：队列做 BFS，每轮先记下这一层有几个节点，再一次处理完这一层。
lc: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal II
Binary Tree Zigzag Level Order Traversal
Average of Levels in Binary Tree
Find Largest Value in Each Tree Row
Maximum Level Sum of a Binary Tree
Populating Next Right Pointers in Each Node

patterns.name: Tree Depth First Search
patterns.when: An answer per path, or an ancestor to descendant relationship
patterns.idea: Go all the way down one branch before trying the next, so every question about a path has the whole path in hand when it reaches the bottom.
patterns.zh: 每条路径要一个答案，或者祖先和后代的关系：递归 DFS，把路径上的状态往下传，把结果往上返回。
lc: Check If a String Is a Valid Sequence from Root to Leaves Path in a Binary Tree

patterns.name: Graphs
patterns.when: Nodes and edges, reachability, connectivity, fewest hops
patterns.idea: Model the input as nodes and edges, then walk it with a queue or a stack, marking what you have seen so nothing is explored twice.
patterns.zh: 节点和边、能不能到达、是否连通、最少几步：先建邻接表，BFS 求最少步数，DFS 求连通，都要记 visited。
lc: Find if Path Exists in Graph
Minimum Number of Vertices to Reach All Nodes

patterns.name: Island (Matrix Traversal)
patterns.when: A 2D grid where neighboring cells form groups
patterns.idea: A grid is a graph where every cell is connected to its neighbors, so counting islands is counting connected components.
patterns.zh: 二维网格里相邻格子连成一块（岛屿、区域）：遇到没访问过的格子就 BFS 或 DFS，把整块都标记掉。

patterns.name: Two Heaps
patterns.when: The median, or the middle, of a stream of numbers
patterns.idea: Split the numbers into a smaller half and a larger half, and the middle of the data sits at the top of the two heaps, ready to read in O(1).
patterns.zh: 数据流的中位数，或者"中间那个"：大顶堆存较小的一半，小顶堆存较大的一半，保持两边个数平衡。

patterns.name: Subsets
patterns.when: Generate all subsets, permutations, or combinations
patterns.idea: Every existing partial answer produces new partial answers when the next element is considered, which builds the whole power set without any recursion.
patterns.zh: 生成所有子集、排列、组合：从空集开始，把每个新元素加到已有的结果上，或者用回溯一个个选或不选。

patterns.name: Modified Binary Search
patterns.when: Sorted, rotated, or monotonic input, or a search over the answer
patterns.idea: Binary search is not about sorted arrays. It works wherever you can look at the middle and rule out half the remaining space.
patterns.zh: 有序、旋转、单调的输入，或者在答案的范围上搜索：每次判断答案在哪一半，O(log n)；边界和终止条件要想清楚。
lc: Find Smallest Letter Greater Than Target
Find First and Last Position of Element in Sorted Array
Search in a Sorted Array of Unknown Size
Peak Index in a Mountain Array
Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array

patterns.name: Bitwise XOR
patterns.when: Everything appears in pairs except one, in O(1) space
patterns.idea: XOR cancels equal pairs, so everything that appears twice disappears and only the odd one out is left.
patterns.zh: 除了一个以外都成对出现，并且要 O(1) 空间：a^a=0、a^0=a，全部异或一遍就只剩单独的那个。

patterns.name: Top K Elements
patterns.when: Top K, Kth largest, or K most frequent
patterns.idea: Keep a heap of exactly K items, and the cost of finding the top K drops from sorting everything to O(n log k).
patterns.zh: 前 K 大、第 K 大、出现最多的 K 个：维护一个大小为 K 的堆（求前 K 大用小顶堆），O(n log k)。
lc: Kth Largest Element in an Array
Kth Largest Element in a Stream

patterns.name: K-way Merge
patterns.when: Several sorted lists merged into one
patterns.idea: Hold one candidate from each sorted list in a heap, and the next smallest element across all of them is always at the top.
patterns.zh: 把好几个有序列表合并成一个：每个列表的第一个放进小顶堆，每次取出最小的，再补进它后面那个。
lc: Kth Smallest Element in a Sorted Matrix
Smallest Range Covering Elements from K Lists
Find K Pairs with Smallest Sums

patterns.name: Greedy Algorithms
patterns.when: One sort makes every choice obvious, and you never look back
patterns.idea: Take the best-looking option at every step and never look back. The sort you choose first is what makes that safe.
patterns.zh: 排一次序以后每一步怎么选都很明显，而且不用回头：每步选当前最好的，关键是说清楚为什么局部最好就是整体最好。
lc: Minimum Add to Make Parentheses Valid
Removing Minimum and Maximum From Array

patterns.name: 0/1 Knapsack
patterns.when: Take it or leave it, under a capacity or a target sum
patterns.idea: One yes-or-no decision per item, and the best answer for each remaining capacity is built from the best answers to smaller capacities.
patterns.zh: 每样东西拿或者不拿，受容量或目标和限制：dp[i][c] 在"不拿"和"拿"里取较好的，常常可以压成一维、倒着遍历。

patterns.name: Fibonacci Numbers
patterns.when: Each answer built from a fixed number of earlier answers
patterns.idea: Each answer is built from a fixed number of earlier answers, so storing those few turns an exponential recursion into one linear pass.
patterns.zh: 每个答案由前面固定几个答案推出来（爬楼梯、打家劫舍）：先写出递推式，再用两三个变量滚动保存。

patterns.name: Palindromic Subsequence
patterns.when: Palindromes, or two strings compared character by character
patterns.idea: The state is a range of the string rather than a position in it, and the answer for a range depends on its two ends plus the range inside them.
patterns.zh: 回文，或者两个字符串逐个字符比较：dp[i][j] 表示区间 i..j（或两个前缀）的答案，从短区间推到长区间。
lc: Minimum Insertion Steps to Make a String Palindrome

patterns.name: Backtracking
patterns.when: Build a configuration, undo it, and prune what cannot work
patterns.idea: Make a choice, recurse, then undo the choice. Cutting off branches that cannot lead anywhere is what separates this from brute force.
patterns.zh: 构造一个方案、撤销、剪掉不可能的分支：选择 → 递归 → 撤销，越早判断不可能，省下的搜索越多。
lc: Split a String Into the Max Number of Unique Substrings

patterns.name: Trie
patterns.when: A dictionary searched by prefix, or autocomplete
patterns.idea: Store words in a tree where each edge is one character, so shared prefixes are stored once and prefix questions cost only the length of the prefix.
patterns.zh: 按前缀查字典、自动补全：每个节点存一个字符，沿着路径往下走就是前缀查询，O(单词长度)。
lc: Design Add and Search Words Data Structure

patterns.name: Topological Sort
patterns.when: Prerequisites, dependencies, or a valid build order
patterns.idea: Order the nodes of a directed graph so every arrow points forward. If that is impossible, the graph has a cycle, which is often the real question.
patterns.zh: 先修课、依赖关系、合法的构建顺序：统计入度，入度为 0 的先入队，BFS 一个个删边；最后还有没处理的说明有环。
lc: Find All Possible Recipes from Given Supplies

patterns.name: Union Find
patterns.when: Connectivity and grouping, while connections keep being added
patterns.idea: Keep track of which things are in the same group, and answer "are these two connected" in almost constant time, even as groups keep merging.
patterns.zh: 一边不断加连接，一边问是否连通、分成几组：find 找根（路径压缩），union 合并两个根，几乎 O(1)。

patterns.name: Ordered Set
patterns.when: The nearest value above or below, in a set that keeps changing
patterns.idea: A hash set answers "is this value here". An ordered set answers "what is the nearest value above or below", while the collection keeps changing.
patterns.zh: 在不断变化的集合里找比某个值大或小的最近值：用有序结构（Python 用 SortedList 或 bisect），插入和查找 O(log n)。
lc: Longest Continuous Subarray With Absolute Diff Less Than or Equal to Limit

patterns.name: Prefix Sum
patterns.when: Many range sums on a fixed array, or counting subarrays
patterns.idea: Compute the running totals once, and the sum of any range becomes the difference between two of them.
patterns.zh: 固定数组上多次求区间和，或者数和为 k 的子数组：先算前缀和，区间和 = P[r] - P[l]，常和 hash map 一起用来计数。
lc: Find the Middle Index in Array
Maximum Size Subarray Sum Equals k
Sum of Absolute Differences in a Sorted Array

patterns.name: Multi-threaded
patterns.when: Threads, ordering, and shared state
patterns.idea: Several threads run at once and the answer has to be correct no matter how they interleave. The goal is correctness under concurrency, not a faster big-O.
patterns.zh: 多线程、执行顺序、共享状态：用锁、信号量、条件变量控制谁先谁后，重点是正确，而不是复杂度。

patterns.name: Counting
patterns.when: Frequency, anagrams, duplicates, the majority element
patterns.idea: Count how many times each value appears, then answer the real question from the counts rather than from the input.
patterns.zh: 频率、字母异位词、重复、多数元素：用 Counter 或固定大小的数组计数，再根据计数回答。
lc: Minimum Increment to Make Array Unique
Minimum Number of Steps to Make Two Strings Anagram
Least Number of Unique Integers after K Removals

patterns.name: Monotonic Queue
patterns.when: A sliding window that also needs its maximum or minimum
patterns.idea: A deque kept in sorted order, so the maximum of a sliding window is always at the front and every window costs O(1) to answer.
patterns.zh: 滑动窗口里还要随时知道最大或最小值：双端队列保持单调，队头就是当前窗口的最值，O(n)。
lc: Longest Continuous Subarray With Absolute Diff Less Than or Equal to Limit
Minimum Number of Coins for Fruits

patterns.name: Simulation
patterns.when: The problem describes a process, and the constraints are small
patterns.idea: Some problems have no shortcut. Model the state, apply the rules exactly as written, and step forward until it stops.
patterns.zh: 题目描述了一个过程，而且数据规模小：按规则一步步模拟，重点是把边界和状态更新写对。

patterns.name: Linear Sorting Algorithms
patterns.when: The values are integers in a small known range
patterns.idea: No comparison sort can beat O(n log n). If you stop comparing and start using the values themselves as positions, you can sort in O(n).
patterns.zh: 值是小范围内的整数：用计数排序、桶排序或基数排序，不用比较，O(n + k)。

patterns.name: Meet in the Middle
patterns.when: Subset search where n is about 30 to 45
patterns.idea: Split the input in half, enumerate each half on its own, then match the two halves against each other. The cost falls from 2^n to about 2^(n/2).
patterns.zh: n 大约 30 到 45 的子集搜索：把数组分成两半，各自枚举所有子集和，再排序加二分把两边配起来。
lc: Partition Array Into Two Arrays to Minimize Sum Difference

patterns.name: Mo's Algorithm
patterns.when: Many offline range queries on an array that never changes
patterns.idea: Answer many range queries by reordering them, so each query's range is close to the last one and the window only has to shuffle a little between answers.
patterns.zh: 不变的数组上有大量离线区间查询：把查询按块排序，左右端点一小步一小步移动，增量更新答案。

patterns.name: Serialize and Deserialize
patterns.when: Encode a structure as text and rebuild it
patterns.idea: Flatten a structure into a string, and rebuild it from that string. The format has to record enough shape that the rebuild is unambiguous.
patterns.zh: 把树或其他结构编码成字符串，再还原回来：选一种遍历顺序，用标记表示空节点，还原时按同样的顺序读。
lc: Verify Preorder Serialization of a Binary Tree

patterns.name: Clone
patterns.when: Deep copy a graph or a structure with extra pointers
patterns.idea: Copy a structure node by node, keeping a map from each original to its copy, so shared links and cycles are reproduced instead of chased forever.
patterns.zh: 深拷贝图，或带额外指针的结构：用 hash map 记"原节点 → 新节点"，先查表再创建，避免重复和死循环。
lc: Clone Binary Tree With Random Pointer
Find a Corresponding Node of a Binary Tree in a Clone of That Tree

patterns.name: Articulation Points and Bridges
patterns.when: Single points of failure in an undirected graph
patterns.idea: Find the single points of failure in a network: the one node, or the one link, whose removal splits the graph in two.
patterns.zh: 无向图里删掉哪个点或哪条边会断开（单点故障）：Tarjan 算法，DFS 时记下发现时间 disc 和能回到的最早时间 low。
lc: Minimum Number of Days to Disconnect Island

patterns.name: Segment Tree
patterns.when: Range queries and updates, including minimum and maximum
patterns.idea: A tree over the array where each node stores the aggregate of a range, so both queries and updates cost O(log n) instead of one being O(n).
patterns.zh: 区间查询加单点或区间更新，包括最大最小值：每个节点存一段区间的结果，查询和更新都是 O(log n)。

patterns.name: Binary Indexed Tree
patterns.when: Prefix sums with updates, and counting smaller elements
patterns.idea: A prefix sum array you can update. Twenty lines of code give you O(log n) updates and O(log n) prefix queries.
patterns.zh: 前缀和需要支持更新，或者统计"比我小的有几个"：树状数组用 lowbit 跳着加，代码比线段树短。
lc: Maximum Profitable Triplets With Increasing Prices I
Queries on a Permutation With Key
Minimum Number of Moves to Make Palindrome
